youtube_description:
Jesus... I told him I forgave him. I smiled when I said it. But every night it plays again. 💔 Bible verse for forgiveness that still hurts.

Her: Jesus... I told him I forgave him. I smiled when I said it. But every night it plays again. 💔

Her: Was my forgiveness fake?

Jesus: It wasn't fake. Forgiveness is a decision you keep making while the feeling catches up.

Her: How many times do I have to forgive the same thing?

Jesus: As many times as it returns. Not for him. So your heart stops carrying him.

"He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds."
Psalm 147:3 (BSB)
